_comment: PUT /api/v1/settings/mcp-servers — GitHub's OFFICIAL remote MCP server, which ships in TrueForge's connector catalog.
_IMPORTANT: TrueForge does NOT expand environment variables in this file. Replace ghp_REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_REAL_PAT with the literal token before sending, or you will store the placeholder verbatim and every turn fails with 'Authorization header is badly formatted'.
_format: The header value must be the single word Bearer, one space, then the token. No braces, no $, no quotes around the token.
_ui: Easier: Settings > Connectors > GitHub > Configure, and paste the PAT. The UI adds the Bearer prefix itself, so paste the RAW token there — not 'Bearer ghp_...'.
_scopes: The PAT needs contents:write, pull_requests:write, metadata:read.

manifest.name: github
manifest.description: Work with issues, pull requests, repository files, and CI status.
